biggest_catch: REJECT — AppKarma is a real, long-running rewards app (10+ years, updated April 2026), but the company publishes no concrete payout terms: no minimum redemption, no point-to-dollar conversion, and no reward schedule appear in any official source. Only program mechanics (install-and-play apps, Karma Plays, quizzes, badges) are officially documented.
catches: The company's own Play Store description (quoted verbatim across app databases) describes earning mechanics — install and play apps, Karma Plays daily rewards, Karma Quizzes, achievement badges, scratch cards, referral cut — but states no minimum redemption and no point conversion rate.
The official site www.appkarma.io is cited in the company's own Play description, but no redemption schedule, minimum, or conversion was obtainable from official sources in this session.
All concrete figures about AppKarma payouts come from third-party reviews and user reports, never the company.

Rating data suggests declining health: AppFollow shows the Play listing at 3.7–2.8 stars with a low reputation index, and review volume is thin for a 10-year-old app — but this is corroborating context, not the reason for rejection.
Same checklist bar as the Mistplay rejection (R0161): legit company, no concrete payout in official terms — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.
